title: Packing disjoint balls centred in an n-dimensional subspace
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, W ⊆ ℝ^N a linear subspace with dim W = n, and Hⁿ := μHE[n]. Let ι be a type, T ⊆ ι a countable set, w : ι → ℝ^N, ρ : ι → ℝ, w₀ ∈ W and R ∈ ℝ. Assume that for all i ∈ T: w(i) ∈ W, ρ(i) > 0 and B(w(i), ρ(i)) ⊆ B(w₀, R). Assume also that the open balls B(w(i), ρ(i)), i ∈ T, are pairwise disjoint. Then Σ_{i∈T} ρ(i)ⁿ ≤ Rⁿ in [0, ∞], i.e. ∑' i : T, ofReal(ρ(i)ⁿ) ≤ ofReal(Rⁿ).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ W = n → ∀ (ι : Type) (T : Set ι) (w : ι → Rn N) (ρ : ι → ℝ) (w₀ : Rn N) (R : ℝ), T.Countable → (∀ i ∈ T, w i ∈ W) → w₀ ∈ W → (∀ i ∈ T, 0 < ρ i) → T.PairwiseDisjoint (fun i ↦ Metric.ball (w i) (ρ i)) → (∀ i ∈ T, Metric.ball (w i) (ρ i) ⊆ Metric.ball w₀ R) → ∑' i : T, ENNReal.ofReal (ρ i ^ n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n)
